question: Which of the following hills is located in the Eastern most part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patkai Bum Hills**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Patkai Bum Hills** are located in the easternmost part of India, along the India-Myanmar border.
 
• The hills are part of a mountain range that extends from Arunachal Pradesh in India to Myanmar.
 
• The region is known for its rich biodiversity and dense forests.
